issues.description: In the solution code PersonResource.deletePerson(...) calls personService.deletePerson(personId) with a UUID parameter, but PersonService.deletePerson(...) in the solution accepts a Person object. This parameter-type mismatch (UUID vs Person) creates a compile-time inconsistency in the solution and contradicts the problem statement which specifies deletion by UUID. The template PersonService uses deletePerson(UUID) which further shows the intended signature is UUID, so the solution deviates from both template and specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the PersonService.deletePerson signature consistent with the REST resource and problem statement by changing it to accept a UUID: public void deletePerson(UUID personId) { this.persons.removeIf(person -> person.getId().equals(personId)); }. Alternatively, adjust PersonResource to obtain the Person and call deletePerson(Person) consistently — but the simpler fix is to restore the UUID parameter to PersonService to match the template and specification.

issues.description: Inconsistent parameter type/name for the deletePerson operation across artifacts: the problem statement and the template expect DELETE /persons/{personId} to remove a person by UUID (PersonService.deletePerson(UUID personId)), but the solution's PersonService defines deletePerson(Person person) while the solution's PersonResource calls personService.deletePerson(personId). This name/type mismatch for the same conceptual operation (deleting a person by id) creates confusion for students and may cause compilation/runtime errors in the solution.
issues.suggestedFix: Make the deletePerson API consistent across artifacts: have PersonService expose deletePerson(UUID personId) (matching the problem statement and template) and update the solution PersonService signature accordingly. Alternatively, if keeping deletePerson(Person) is intended, update PersonResource to resolve the Person object before calling the service or add an overload deletePerson(UUID) that delegates to deletePerson(Person). Ensure parameter names/types match (personId : UUID) to avoid student confusion.
